title: Grateful Dead Live at Glens Falls Civic Center on 1982-04-14
lineage: Master Cassette > Nakamichi Dragon (Modified by Stephen Sank) with Dolby B > HHB CDR 830plus > EAC > Sound Forge 5.0 (tape flip splice) > CD Wave Editor 1.71 > WAV > SHN,  or > FLAC
source: Audience Recording: 2 Sennheiser MD421's > Sony TC-D5M 10th row (sec 102 row J seat 3) 7-8' stand, Maxell MX90 cassettes with Dolby B

ai_review.summary: Clear audience tape of an early‑April ’82 show that burns with high energy – China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Lazy Lightning > Supplication and a dreamy Playin’ in the Band jam stand out.
ai_review.review: The recording is an AUD source that sounds surprisingly clear for a crowd capture, letting the band’s excitement shine through. The concert is charged from the opening “Big River” vocal to a soaring second‑set sequence of China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider and a jazzy Brent‑space Playin’ in the Band, despite Bobby’s cold‑affected start. Overall the performance is vibrant and the tape captures it well.

ai_rating.rationale: Four solid reviews (average 4.25★) praise both the musical energy and the surprisingly good audience recording; only minor criticism of a few lyrical slips.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note clear, crisp sound for an AUD tape, comparable to other early‑80s audience recordings; no major dropouts mentioned, just typical crowd ambience.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Playin' in the Band (jazzy Brent space)
poor_songs: "LL" (lyrics blown at start due to Bobby's cold)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic opening with a vocal‑driven Big River, solid first set ending on Bertha; second set builds momentum through China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and reaches a peak with the Playin' in the Band jam before closing strong.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Aggressive vocal on Big River, percussive licks, bluegrass run, heavy & fluid solo work, dreamy riffs that steer the band; praised as “perfect” and “breathtaking.”
band_member_comments.Bob: Cold during early songs, blew beginning of LL lyrics, but recovers and plays great throughout the jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland provides a jazzy space during Playin' in the Band that is highlighted as dreamy and inventive.
